q2: SELECT b, (max_price - min_price), avg_price FROM (SELECT beer AS b, MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE bar IN (SELECT bar FROM (SELECT bar, COUNT(*) AS servecount FROM serves WHERE bar IN (SELECT bar FROM frequents WHERE drinker LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY bar ORDER BY bar) AS barandcount WHERE servecount >= 2) AND /* to here then filter beers to choose from */ beer IN (SELECT DISTINCT beer FROM (SELECT beer, COUNT(*) AS servebeercount FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS beercounttable WHERE servebeercount > 2) GROUP BY beer) AS beertable
